title: Crediting a Kestrel Care Cancellation Refund to a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — cancellation refunds from a financed Kestrel Care plan**

**Clause.** A Kestrel Care refund can be credited to the lease balance only while the lease status is active or maturity extended. A cancellation refund from a Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract financed in the lease is credited to the adjusted lease balance and does not change the monthly payment. When the lease is in any other status the refund is paid to the lessee by check instead and is not credited to the lease.

| Lease status | Cancellation refund of a Care plan financed in the lease |
|---|---|
| Active | credited to the adjusted lease balance; monthly payment unchanged |
| Maturity extended | credited to the adjusted lease balance; monthly payment unchanged |
| Any other status (for example returned, early terminated, repossessed) | paid to the lessee by check; not credited to the lease |

**Hypothetical illustration**: a lessee cancels a Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract that was financed in an active lease, and a refund of $812.40 results. The adjusted lease balance falls by $812.40; the total monthly payment stays as it was. Had the vehicle already been turned in, the $812.40 would be paid by check.
